title: Apache Spark using Scala
overview: This course provides an in-depth understanding of Apache Spark using Scala, Spark’s native language. Participants will learn Spark's core architecture, RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, structured streaming, and machine learning with MLlib, focusing on how Scala enhances Spark’s performance and scalability. Hands-on labs will cover building efficient big data pipelines, optimizing Spark jobs, and deploying real-world applications.
audience: Big Data Engineers working on distributed data processing
Scala Developers looking to integrate Apache Spark
Data Scientists needing scalable ML workflows
Software Engineers developing real-time analytics solutions
Cloud & DevOps Professionals working with Spark clusters
Data Analysts handling massive datasets in Spark
methodology: Hands-on Coding Labs – Writing and executing Spark applications in Scala
Live Demonstrations – Showcasing Spark’s capabilities with real-world data
Use Case Studies – Applying Spark in business and industry scenarios
Collaborative Learning – Group problem-solving and interactive discussions
Capstone Project – Implementing an end-to-end Spark-based big data pipeline
competencies: Apache Spark’s Core Components & Execution Model
Working with Spark RDDs, DataFrames & Spark SQL
Distributed Data Processing using Scala in Spark
Real-Time Streaming with Spark Structured Streaming
Deploying & Managing Spark Applications in Production
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand Apache Spark’s architecture, components, and Scala’s role
Implement Spark transformations and actions using Scala
Process structured and semi-structured data using DataFrames and Spark SQL
Optimize Spark jobs for efficient performance
Develop machine learning models using MLlib
Stream and process real-time data using Spark Structured Streaming
Deploy Spark applications on cloud and on-premises clusters

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Apache Spark & Scala

items.text: Overview of Big Data & Distributed Computing
What is Apache Spark? – Evolution, Use Cases, and Benefits
Spark Ecosystem: Core, SQL, Streaming, MLlib, GraphX
Setting up Scala Development Environment for Spark
Introduction to Scala Syntax, Data Types, and Functional Programming

outline.title: Module 2: Apache Spark Architecture & Execution Model

items.text: Understanding Spark Cluster Components – Driver, Executors, Tasks
RDDs vs. DataFrames vs. Datasets – Key Differences
Spark Execution Model: Transformations & Actions
Memory Management & Data Partitioning in Spark
Deploying Spark Applications in Local & Cluster Mode

outline.title: Module 3: Working with Spark RDDs in Scala

items.text: Introduction to Resilient Distributed Datasets (RDDs)
Creating, Transforming, and Persisting RDDs
Lazy Evaluation & Fault Tolerance in Spark
Common RDD Operations: map, filter, flatMap, reduceByKey
Performance Optimization: Shuffling, Partitioning, and Caching

outline.title: Module 4: DataFrames & Spark SQL in Scala

items.text: Introduction to DataFrames & Datasets
Creating DataFrames from CSV, JSON, Parquet & JDBC
Performing Data Transformations and Aggregations
Using Spark SQL for Querying Structured Data
Performance Optimization using Catalyst Optimizer

outline.title: Module 5: Advanced Data Engineering with Apache Spark

items.text: Partitioning & Bucketing for Performance Optimization
Handling Schema Evolution & Nested Data Structures
Integration with Cloud Storage (AWS S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage)
Managing Data Workflows with Apache Airflow & Apache Kafka

outline.title: Module 6: Machine Learning with Spark MLlib in Scala

items.text: Introduction to Spark MLlib for Scalable Machine Learning
Feature Engineering & Data Preprocessing in Spark
Training & Evaluating ML Models
Building End-to-End ML Pipelines in Spark
Hyperparameter Tuning & Model Deployment

outline.title: Module 7: Real-Time Data Processing with Spark Streaming

items.text: Introduction to Spark Structured Streaming
Streaming Data Sources – Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Azure Event Hubs
Stateful & Event-Time Processing with Structured Streaming
Handling Late Arriving & Out-of-Order Data
Real-World Streaming Use Cases – Fraud Detection, IoT Analytics

outline.title: Module 8: Performance Optimization & Debugging in Spark

items.text: Understanding Spark UI & Job Execution Plan
Best Practices for Memory Management & Shuffle Optimization
Broadcast Variables & Accumulators for Performance
Debugging Spark Applications & Handling Failures
Optimizing Scala Code for Spark Performance
Running Spark on Standalone, YARN, and Kubernetes Clusters
Deploying Spark Applications on AWS EMR, Azure HDInsight, GCP Dataproc
CI/CD Pipelines for Spark Applications
Using Databricks for Scalable Spark Deployments
